title: Lanterns: What Changed in the Series with the 5th Episode
seoTitle: Lanterns: What Changed with the 5th Episode
subtitle: The fourth chapter intensifies the investigation in Rushville
excerpt: The 5th episode of Lanterns premiered on September 13, bringing new revelations about Hal Jordan and John Stewart, deepening their tension and intensifying the plot.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 5th episode of Lanterns, titled "Lights Out," premiered on HBO Max on September 13, at 10 PM Brasília time. The chapter, the penultimate of the season, continues Hal Jordan and John Stewart's investigation into the mysterious Manhunter, deepening the conflicts between the two Lanterns.

What Changes in the 5th Episode of Lanterns

The episode introduces a new phase of the investigation, with the central setting being the escalating chaos in Rushville. Hal's decision puts the partnership between the protagonists in a delicate situation, increasing the tension that had already been building since the fourth chapter, "The Weenie."

Comic Book References Appearing in the Series

The series continues to hide references to the Green Lantern comics. Among them are the origin of Hal Jordan, who received the ring from Abin Sur, and the presence of Sinestro, Hal's former mentor. These references maintain the connection to the DC Universe and help contextualize the story for fans.

The DC Shared Universe in the New Phase

Lanterns is part of the DC shared universe, alongside Superman, Peacemaker, and Creature Commandos. The production, developed by James Gunn and Peter Safran, aims to create continuity between films, series, and animations, allowing characters to circulate between productions. Thus, Hal Jordan and John Stewart officially exist in the same reality as Superman, Guy Gardner, Hawkgirl, and Mister Terrific.

How the Series Maintains Suspense in the Investigation

The series maintains suspense by introducing new elements into the Rushville setting. The discovery of a new Manhunter and the revelation that the target may be closer than imagined increase the complexity of the plot, keeping viewers attentive to the story's unfolding.

The Impact of the New Phase on Character Dynamics

With Hal's decision and the intensification of the investigation, the dynamic between the two protagonists becomes more complicated. The tension between Hal and John, which was already evident, gains depth, reflecting the differences in approach and personality that characterize each one.
